arStrings.szText: Hammer of the Ancients
Fury Skill: Slam your weapon down with the fury of the ancients, dealing heavy damage to a concentrated area.
Gain {c_number}[{SF_9} * 100|%x|]{/c} more Fury for {c_number}[SF_17]{/c} seconds for each enemy damaged by {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c}, stacking up to {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} times.
Enhanced Hammer of the Ancients
{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} quakes outward and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Explosive

{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} forms a seismic line that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE}{/c} and Slows enemies hit by {c_number}[SF_38 * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_39]{/c} seconds.
Fissure

{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} now deals Fire damage.

Casting {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} Summons {c_number}[SF_37]{/c} Ancients to hammer the same area for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage each. If Burning enemies are struck {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} explodes, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_EXPLOSION_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Ancestral

{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_12} * 100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance for every {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} Maximum Fury you have, up to {c_number}[{SF_12} * {SF_45} * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance at {c_number}[{SF_20}*{SF_45}]{/c} Maximum Fury.

Current bonus: {c_number}[{SF_46}*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance.
Critical Strike
{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_47}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Size and {c_number}[{SF_48}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
Size and Damage Bonus

Gain {c_number}[{SF_43}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Fury Generation for {c_number}[{SF_44}]{/c} seconds for each enemy damaged by {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_43}*{SF_42}*100|+%|]{/c}.
Fury Generation
{c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage if you have {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
Overpower
